# Thimadu Auto Traders

Thimadu Auto Traders is a Sri Lankan vehicle business website focused on current vehicle discovery, vehicle-selling enquiries, specific-model sourcing requests, vehicle information and direct customer support.

## Primary pages
- /index.html — business overview and current services
- /all-vehicles.html — live vehicle catalogue and cars for sale in Sri Lanka
- /car-details.html — exact vehicle details, photos, price and availability
- /services.html — vehicle service overview
- /sell-your-vehicle-sri-lanka.html — vehicle selling support
- /vehicle-sourcing-sri-lanka.html — specific vehicle sourcing requests
- /vehicle-information-support.html — vehicle information and supporting-document enquiries
- /reviews.html — published customer stories and videos
- /aboutus.html — detailed company approach, processes and information standards

## Contact
Phone / WhatsApp: +94 77 181 3928
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/thimaducar
Service area: Sri Lanka

## Data accuracy
Vehicle availability, pricing and supporting records can change. The live catalogue helps customers shortlist; decision-critical details should be confirmed with the Thimadu vehicle desk for the exact stock item. Customer stories and videos are displayed only from published Active database records.
